correctness.rationale: Every selected tree has k cuts and k spokes alternating cyclically, because each of the k rim path components must contain exactly one spoke; the converse is acyclic and connected. Marking a spoke and taking half-step gaps is a bijection to a rim vertex and a uniform 2k-part weak composition of n-k, proving exact c_nk and product-of-component-sizes probabilities. The polynomial gives \(c_{n,k}/n^{2k}\) tends to \(2/(2k)!\) with a summable uniform factorial bound, hence total-variation Poisson-even convergence at \(t=s/n^2\). Uniform weak compositions converge to \(\operatorname{Dirichlet}(1,\ldots,1)\), and pairing gaps gives \(\operatorname{Dirichlet}(2,\ldots,2)\). Every \(3\le n\le8\) spanning tree was independently enumerated; 5,458 exact checker comparisons passed. Finite checks are supporting, not a substitute for the all-n proof.
